messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: metering.alert.high_token_drift triggered for service 'metering-agg'
incidents-bot: Severity: high — paging oncall @sara
sara (oncall): I'm on it, starting triage. @ajay can you pull ingest logs for the last 15m?
ajay: grabbing logs, consumer lag for group 'meter-emit' spiked ~2000 msgs around 02:11Z
sara (oncall): any customer-facing flags yet? @maria-cs?
maria-cs: CS queue shows 3 customers with billing flag emails started arriving ~02:25Z, no escalations yet
leo: seeing a slow token-count slope in aggregate: +0.8% over 30m, looks like progressive double-counting rather than a single burst
ajay: tailing emitter logs -> repeated ack timeouts to emitter v2 at 02:12:45Z. snippet:
```
WARN emitter: resend msg_id=abc123 attempts=3 ack_timeout=120ms
DEBUG emitter: sent copy to partition 5
```
sara (oncall): hypothesis: emitter retry replays are being accepted by aggregator within same counting window, causing incremental creep. can we filter by producer id and event_id?
ajay: yes — filtering by producer_id=gw-07 shows a high dup ratio; sample query:
```
SELECT event_id, count(*) FROM ingest WHERE producer_id='gw-07' AND ts >= '2026-03-18T02:00:00Z' GROUP BY event_id HAVING count(*) > 1 LIMIT 10;
```
ajay: initial run found ~12k event_ids with count>1 in last 20m
ops-pager: mitigation action: mirror 'ingest-v2' -> 'ingest-v2-standby' and pause downstream billing flagging (feature flag metering.flags.pause=true)
sara (oncall): executing short-term mitigations: 1) enable dedupe lambda on standby stream, 2) pause flagging, 3) keep emitters routed to standby while we observe
ajay: dedupe lambda (v1.3) started, using event_id dedupe window=5m. first 5m run removed ~12k duplicate events
maria-cs: drafting customer comms: "We're investigating intermittent billing noise affecting a small subset of customers; counts are stabilizing and no billing action required at this time." Will send once we have stability confirmation
sara (oncall): monitoring token delta -> slope reduced to +0.1% over 10m after dedupe. good sign :thumbsup:
leo: grabbing ledger snapshot for recon; will run compare job in 30m and post results
sara (oncall): plan if stable for 1h: unpause flagging, keep standby mirroring for additional 1h, then rollback emitter v2 to stop aggressive retries. ack? @ajay
ajay: ack. keeping standby routing and dedupe for at least 1h post-stability
maria-cs: customer update sent at 02:45Z to affected accounts; CS on standby for responses
sara (oncall): followups to log in the incident: 1) postmortem, 2) emitter retry backoff tuning, 3) upstream dedupe at producer edge, 4) alert threshold refinement to catch slope patterns
sara (oncall): closing pager for active paging — moving thread to #incidents for post-incident writeup
incidents-bot: Pager: acknowledgment recorded by sara at 1840000001
